persona_statements: My father is in the army. I recently was fired and had to get a new job. I work in the insurance business. My mom passed away when I was young.
I want to travel the world taking photographs of my travels. I like taking pictures. I am a widow.
I ride horses. I collect vintage cars. I try to limit how much meat I eat for health reasons. I have many homes.
I speak english and spanish fluently. I like listening to blues music. I am mixed with puerto rican and chinese. I am from Germany. My favorite artist was prince.
My neighbor comes over all the time to watch rugby with me. My car broke down last week. I like to fly kites. I love sports, but rugby is my favorite.
